keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Felipe Sánchez (Santos Laguna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Kevin Palacios replaces Jonathan Pérez.
Delay in match because of an injury Mauricio Cuevas (Santos Laguna).
Delay in match because of an injury Juan Valencia (Necaxa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Santos Laguna 0, Necaxa 0.
Mauro Zaleta (Necaxa) is shown the yellow card.
Diego Ochoa (Necaxa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Necaxa. Kevin Rosero replaces Juan Valencia.
Lorenzo Faravelli (Necaxa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Necaxa. Joshua Palacios replaces Lorenzo Faravelli.
Substitution, Necaxa. Emilio Martínez replaces Mauro Zaleta.
Substitution, Necaxa. Matías Espíndola replaces Owen González.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Esteban Lozano replaces Eduardo Aguirre.
Own Goal by Matías Espíndola, Necaxa. Santos Laguna 1, Necaxa 0.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Aldo López replaces Fran Villalba.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Javier Güémez replaces Tahiel Jiménez.
Substitution, Necaxa. Leonardo Arvizo replaces Raúl Martínez.
Delay in match because of an injury Diego Ochoa (Necaxa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
